# aws-identity

IAM least privilege (wildcard grants, session duration) and Cognito pool posture (MFA, deletion protection) as measured by the iam-role/cognito dump readers.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-IAM-001` | high | Inline role policy grants wildcard actions |
| `AF-IAM-002` | high | Inline role policy grants wildcard resources |
| `AF-IAM-003` | low | Role session duration exceeds 12 hours |
| `AF-IAM-004` | medium | Cognito user pool has MFA off |
| `AF-IAM-005` | low | Cognito user pool has deletion protection inactive |
